root_cause: The decoder assumed the ADPCM_IMA_MAGIX bitstream always has two channels and derived its inner loop bound from avctx->block_align directly instead of from the sample count computed consistently with the output frame's allocation (get_nb_samples). No explicit handling/rejection of mono streams was added, despite the implementation only being correct for stereo.
findings: The ADPCM_IMA_MAGIX decode case unconditionally decodes into two channel status structs (c->status[0] and c->status[1]) inside its inner sample-expansion loop, regardless of the actual number of channels (mono streams only have status[0] initialized/valid, and the output 'samples' buffer for mono has half the per-iteration capacity that the loop assumes).
